# Your First CSS Code

#### Course: CSS Fundamentals for Your First Webpage

## Your First CSS Code

Now, let's write your first CSS code.

```html
1<p>My first CSS code.</p>
```

```css
1p {
2    color: blue;
3}
```

When you run the code, you'll see that the text color of the paragraph is blue.

![Your First CSS Code on browser](data:application/octet-stream;base64,)

Next, you'll learn the CSS syntax and understand how the above code works.
